title: knautia drymeja
intro: Knautia drymeja, commonly known as Blue Sage, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Eastern Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Knautia drymeja include its ability to treat respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of Knautia drymeja include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects.
